Fragment is not claimed to identify an individual paragraph.","blocks":[{"id":"block-000012-0c9422dc","ordinal":12,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["Cover page"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[15]","text":"For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025","text_sha256":"0c9422dc992f25cb91bf0a76fbcfd27f5b0e1b13d03d061c4a11ba498f6f2046","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_1","reported_page":2},{"id":"block-000061-495768bd","ordinal":61,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[65]","text":"PART I","text_sha256":"495768bd3d6957619d4fbe2457811a0483df9e815938bdd9fb195935ece1b264","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_13","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000062-5c0c0c66","ordinal":62,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[67]","text":"ITEM 1.BUSINESS","text_sha256":"5c0c0c66085acdce4a7a67d4882a64e61ceed1d7430c9bffd8ab304b5f8253ee","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_16","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000063-d4b1ea57","ordinal":63,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Overview"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[69]","text":"Overview","text_sha256":"d4b1ea5708dd532930a85188b45aff6f0a3ed458500c7577e0127a538eb0d100","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000064-0c6683ca","ordinal":64,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Overview"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[70]","text":"As our founders Larry and Sergey wrote in the original founders' letter, \"Google is not a conventional company. We do not intend to become one.\" That unconventional spirit has been a driving force throughout our history, inspiring us to tackle big problems and invest in moonshots. It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company. We continue this work under the leadership of Alphabet and Google CEO, Sundar Pichai.","text_sha256":"0c6683ca3ecc8367796b5d5934b2864ce71d473e85fbba2b931887e8144790c8","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000065-ab2556c8","ordinal":65,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Overview"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[71]","text":"Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.","text_sha256":"ab2556c8c13f84c98da87bfca59a6ac497b3b7fe3850f9bc849621e872e9dddc","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000066-068fa324","ordinal":66,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Access and Technology for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[72]","text":"Access and Technology for Everyone","text_sha256":"068fa324640fb2b537c22bbcb2cf22e143f71d0e65a5001b1572b759272f92de","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000067-5f2ed3aa","ordinal":67,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Access and Technology for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[73]","text":"The Internet is one of the world’s most powerful equalizers; it propels ideas, people, and businesses large and small. Our mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful is as relevant today as it was when we were founded in 1998. Since then, we have evolved from a company that helps people find answers to a company that also helps people get things done.","text_sha256":"5f2ed3aa2e92eb17b139afd9de88454624c870c84dd6be9f05f133ad55991d7a","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000068-ab181097","ordinal":68,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Access and Technology for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[74]","text":"We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.","text_sha256":"ab181097c313f6cf2a0e7dec1c9af49d699588114f66f70364289c8239d8b305","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":3},{"id":"block-000071-2012752f","ordinal":71,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[77]","text":"Making AI Helpful for Everyone","text_sha256":"2012752f97d68832276ba98b871fdf7b4bd00fcceae9d42d3e567f6ef0e4618c","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000072-46037f96","ordinal":72,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[78]","text":"We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises.","text_sha256":"46037f96e9a42e04c3de8e91e2ea63e4e35ae207d0c7f57cdd4eda9cfa16640a","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000073-8371f0be","ordinal":73,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[79]","text":"At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development.","text_sha256":"8371f0be8b31f9fb79c01de33a080d5633ac7e7012ba58492daa0baaf088dd58","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000074-cb9cb3f3","ordinal":74,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[80]","text":"Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app.","text_sha256":"cb9cb3f3a70d2f53a18b0e615d3e298fcd5d8df9a0b6c117d74a64dd322108a0","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000075-05305a43","ordinal":75,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[81]","text":"As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. For our Google Cloud customers, our offerings are helping organizations stay at the forefront of innovation with solutions such as Gemini Enterprise and Gemini for Google Workspace.","text_sha256":"05305a43aabf512c56de8da598c68144782d7c37222de012a763b08783081c25","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000076-bfd47c66","ordinal":76,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Making AI Helpful for Everyone"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[82]","text":"Guided by our AI principles, we believe our approach to AI must be both bold and responsible. That means developing AI in a way that maximizes the positive benefits to society while addressing its potential challenges.","text_sha256":"bfd47c66180bf25e9bb8d8ef0a17fd1e0a670398963dc26d961e9430cd9e4a78","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000077-7664792a","ordinal":77,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Moonshots"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[83]","text":"Moonshots","text_sha256":"7664792a52f0fe195b5d988eb5975e051f3ac4c9b012c1496a07f79775824715","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000078-6fc7e995","ordinal":78,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Moonshots"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[84]","text":"Many companies get comfortable doing what they have always done, making only incremental changes. This incrementalism leads to irrelevance over time, especially in technology, where change tends to be revolutionary, not evolutionary.","text_sha256":"6fc7e995955364b7745c7927f4bfbe7b27ecb1c74f11e27af38517b08b078c50","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000079-1028dedb","ordinal":79,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Moonshots"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[85]","text":"Our early investments in AI started out as moonshots but are now incorporated into our core products and central to future developments. In Other Bets, our fully autonomous driving technology company, Waymo, is now providing fully autonomous, paid ride-hailing services to customers in multiple cities. Isomorphic Labs is reimagining the drug discovery process from first principles, applying AI to accelerate the development of new medicines. We continue to look toward the future and to invest for the long term, most notably for the application of AI to our products and services, as well as other frontier technologies such as quantum computing.","text_sha256":"1028dedb6e572f5bc124f1529dac648d94f2e2f6ae7017de40b1c5771ca04c15","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000080-c05a319b","ordinal":80,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Privacy and Security"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[86]","text":"Privacy and Security","text_sha256":"c05a319b68060d02b74f81c2c337b6c5fe68cc8f9567327328d42770ccdb82cd","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000081-f0af3678","ordinal":81,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Privacy and Security"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[87]","text":"We make it a priority to protect the privacy and security of our products, users, and customers, even if there are near-term financial consequences. We do this by continuously investing in building products that are secure by default; strictly upholding responsible data practices that emphasize privacy by design; and building easy-to-use settings that put people in control. We are continually enhancing these efforts over time, whether by enabling users to auto-delete their data, applying privacy technologies like on-device processing, giving people tools to control their experience, or advancing anti-malware, anti-phishing, and password security features.","text_sha256":"f0af36788acad032126553327b96c4a7381292f6b82fe4993401921345d6068f","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000082-ce770667","ordinal":82,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","Serving Our Users"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[91]","text":"Serving Our Users","text_sha256":"a818b2d1f97edfbc118d8dd103014b9a1ee8a821708102c919fa959461686c67","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000086-7bd7f443","ordinal":86,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","Serving Our Users"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[92]","text":"We have always been committed to building helpful products that can improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. Our product innovations are what make our services widely used, and our brand one of the most recognized in the world. Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.","text_sha256":"7bd7f443cbee4325873c6cb0afa19d968c25e274613d5131e7735d3192ffc627","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":4},{"id":"block-000089-778b3180","ordinal":89,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","Serving Our Users"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[95]","text":"Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. For example, AI Overviews makes it easier to ask Google anything and get a helpful response. AI Mode allows users to ask more nuanced questions that might have previously taken multiple searches, using Gemini’s advanced reasoning, thinking, and multimodal capabilities.","text_sha256":"778b3180e1d3e2ae55cbb71f6cbc741761b62618871bf62effbdc29206be5acb","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000090-eec5429f","ordinal":90,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","Serving Our Users"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[96]","text":"This drive to make information more accessible and helpful has led us over the years to improve the discovery and creation of digital content both on the web and through platforms like Google Play and YouTube. People are consuming many forms of digital content, including watching long and short form videos and podcasts, streaming TV, playing games, listening to music, reading books, and using apps. Working with content creators and partners, we continue to build new ways for people around the world to create and find great digital content.","text_sha256":"eec5429fd49f68bb1fe17a36a52b337b53f6d847c72bf7186d3d0348afbc435a","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000091-f900cbea","ordinal":91,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","Serving Our Users"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[97]","text":"Fueling all of these great digital experiences are extraordinary platforms and devices. That is why we continue to invest in platforms like our Android mobile operating system, Chrome browser, and Chrome operating system, as well as our family of devices. We see tremendous potential for devices to be helpful and make people's lives easier by combining the best of our AI, software, and hardware. This potential is reflected in our latest generation of devices, such as the new Pixel 10 series and the Pixel Watch 4. Creating products and services that people rely on every day is a journey that we are investing in for the long-term.","text_sha256":"f900cbeac5c8ce8c91b93579aaf11cceda09dc588443f21633bead87bf3bf55c","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000092-fbbe030c","ordinal":92,"type":"heading_candidate","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[98]","text":"How We Make Money","text_sha256":"fbbe030c198cb4d3861b303c5f6577772ecf4cedd675a80502addd049a5262ee","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000093-02c6e3d3","ordinal":93,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[99]","text":"We have built world-class advertising technologies for advertisers, agencies, and publishers to power their digital marketing businesses. Our advertising solutions help millions of companies grow their businesses through our wide range of products across devices and formats, and we aim to ensure positive user experiences by serving the right ads at the right time and by building deep partnerships with brands and agencies. AI has been foundational to our advertising business for more than a decade. Products like Demand Gen, Performance Max, and Product Studio use the full power of our AI to help advertisers find untapped and incremental conversion opportunities.","text_sha256":"02c6e3d34a01c9f206ace7c047738a79154602c4e1425b716f2c325195410664","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000094-0c7f9036","ordinal":94,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[100]","text":"Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties (\"Google Network properties\"). We continue to invest in both performance and brand advertising and seek to improve the measurability of advertising so advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns.","text_sha256":"0c7f90368d1c0afccc25c1019c26787fda62248d39a91b6c43d6761b322bd7a1","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000095-e4c14dea","ordinal":95,"type":"list_item","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[101]","text":"•Performance advertising creates and delivers relevant ads that users will click on leading to direct engagement with advertisers. Performance advertising lets our advertisers connect with users while driving measurable results. Our ads tools allow performance advertisers to create simple text-based ads.","text_sha256":"e4c14dea6e1392ccf690818ca9d24be02d6a3339cacb864f5b3bde406626643a","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000096-9dac0973","ordinal":96,"type":"list_item","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[102]","text":"•Brand advertising helps enhance users' awareness of and affinity for advertisers' products and services, through videos, text, images, and other interactive ads that run across various devices. We help brand advertisers deliver digital videos and other types of ads to specific audiences for their brand-building marketing campaigns.","text_sha256":"9dac0973a1e785f28b73570e1d02688aa82354196daa30577d951d3a96142a06","fragment":"i6be430fe3ebf411481dcec8b0abe9149_19","reported_page":5},{"id":"block-000097-ac27b3a6","ordinal":97,"type":"paragraph","section_path":["PART I","ITEM 1.BUSINESS","Google","Google Services","How We Make Money"],"source_dom_path":"/html/body/div[103]","text":"We have allocated substantial resources to stopping bad advertising practices and protecting users on the web. ## 从明确的输入开始

需要调用方明确公司身份、报告/版本、期间、来源及内容 hash、阅读目的、输入路径和输出位置。财年名称、期间结束日、披露日期分别保留；并排图不自动代表同一期间。缺失或冲突的范围直接列为缺口，不替换为熟悉公司、最新报告或目录中的首份材料。

可从已冻结的原文提取候选，或改善现有 `BusinessMap` 的表达。复用 [BusinessMap 契约](../../src/uteki/domain/business_map/models.py)，用 `business_map_from_dict` 验证。收入图另读带证据的财务记录；BusinessMap 的收入分类名称不是金额数据。不要为画图另建一套业务实体类型。

## 先整理事实与关系

- 区分公司、报告分部、业务、产品服务组、收入分类。应用平台、市场、品牌、法律实体和报告分部不是同一概念；现有枚举不足时，用现有合理类型加明确角色说明，保留未知，不生造会计身份。
- 每个节点及关系绑定 `evidence_ids`；赚钱方式分别标 `explicit`、`derived` 或 `unknown`。归组、推断和翻译不得隐藏原文限定。节点/边的判断依据可保存在 metadata，但应说明元数据约定，不冒称域契约已有强制字段。
- 证据要包含来源、精确文本、块/段或页位置与可访问锚点。记录文本规范化和 hash 对象；原始 PDF、派生 HTML 与摘录页分别标明。只有整份报告链接时，先暴露定位缺口。
- 数据中可保留分部、商业产品组与收入类别，但业务图不把 `revenue_component_of` 与“包含/属于”并列画出，也不用颜色替代拆图。移除收入分类的展示前，回到原文核对实际经营活动；广告等核心业务不能因此消失，不能只修改收入节点的 `kind` 就冒充业务提取。
- 业务与收入类别可以多对多，每条映射须有证据；名称相近不代表一对一。映射不能反推独立产品收入。付费方式不等于金额，合并披露不能按产品拆数。
- 跨业务共用技术只保留同一业务身份。显示别名或重复入口时明确它们指向同一 ID，不制造第二个实体。
- 留下已读范围、未展开项及来源缺口。没有找到、没有读取与没有披露分开记录。

## 按问题选择图

| 读者的问题/数据结构 | 合适的表达 | 容易误导的表达 |
|---|---|---|
| 公司有哪些分部、业务和产品？主要是单一归属关系 | 层次树；按文字长度、分支数量选择从左到右或从上到下 | 把所有节点放在同一层；把共享支持关系硬改成唯一归属 |
| 选定期间收入由哪些类别构成？ | 单独收入图；核定数据后选条形、饼或环形图 | 把收入分类挂在业务树上；把产品清单直接变成饼图 |
| 已有清晰的抽象层次、依赖层级或有序等级 | 分层图；确有上/下层语义时可用金字塔，并标明层次含义 | 为美观制造优先级；让底部面积暗示更大收入或重要性 |
| 同时有报告归属与多个市场、共享服务关系 | 主图说明归属，辅图展开市场/支持关系；通过相同 ID 联动 | 把不同维度并入同一收入树；为减少交叉而删除真实关系 |
| 问题是客户、产品、收费方式的对应关系 | 简洁关系图或图加小表，明确每种连线含义 | 用归属箭头替代交易、支持或因果关系 |

不强制固定节点数或三层。主图只放回答当前问题所需的层级；长产品清单、收费说明和原文放入可展开详情。拆分图时列明各视图覆盖的节点与边，并保证完整数据仍可查。

业务图用非量化节点。节点大小、金字塔面积、连线粗细和排序不能冒充收入、利润或增长权重。若只表达布局，图例明确“大小不表示财务权重”。

收入图须先核定公司、期间、币种/单位、收入定义、合并范围和分母，使用同一披露维度下互斥、穷尽且能勾稽的类别。总项与子项不能重复相加，分部、地区和产品维度不能混拼；显示准确金额、期间、单位、合计与来源，舍入差异按原披露精度说明。

饼/环形仅用于分母大于零且各项非负的完整构成。收入负调整、抵销或其他带符号项目用带正负轴的条形/勾稽表，保留正负号，不能取绝对值、截零或塞进饼图。合并收入只按合并口径呈现。缺数、分母未知、范围不全或勾稽失败时显示具体缺口，可列出已知记录，但不画成完整收入构成，不补零或虚构“其他”。

## 哪些规则固定，哪些可以优化

固定的是业务身份、关系含义、来源范围、证据与审阅状态。布局可以改变，但这些事实不能随布局改变。可调的是展开方向、主图/辅图分工、默认展开深度、标签换行、间距与配色；将有效设置保存在渲染配置中，不把一次成功的外观写成唯一模板。

主图优先使用短标签和一致的阅读方向；完整名称与长解释留在详情。用间距表达分组，用文字与线型表达关系。密集图先拆阅读问题，再调整字号。一次只比较一个清晰度目标，例如“能否找到共享技术支持的全部业务”，用户认可后再沉淀对应做法。

## 从契约生成可见图

1. 保留稳定业务 ID，生成 Mermaid 安全 ID，并保存二者映射。节点短标签优先中文，保留官方英文名称；同一概念不要换多个译名。
2. 保持领域关系方向：`reported_under`、`part_of` 的来源指向其归属；`supports` 从提供支持的一方指向被支持方。数据中的 `revenue_component_of` 保持原义，交给收入视图，不渲染为业务树边。若为了自上而下阅读而反向画线，使用准确的逆向标签，例如“包含”或“支撑来自”，且不改 JSON 端点。上下位置本身不是关系。
3. 同一维度中的不同关系依赖线型与文字区分，不能只靠颜色。市场、应用平台和报告分部使用可见角色标签。对大量交叉边拆主图/辅图；需要检查业务—收入映射时用单独映射视图或详情，不把两种结构重新混进一张树。
4. 业务图交付 Mermaid 源码和实际生成的 SVG 或可访问图页；收入图交付可复核数值与实际图表，不必强用 Mermaid。只交源码、空容器或截图不等于交付可见且可追溯的图。渲染失败时明确失败阶段，保留可用数据与源码。
5. 对报告文字和模型输出做转义；不将其作为 HTML、脚本或 Mermaid 指令执行。使用已可用的渲染器及明确配置；不要为样式改动调用模型、部署或引入远端运行依赖。
6. 节点或关系详情显示定义、赚钱方式、判断依据和证据入口。交互受限时提供旁置的编号证据表。保留完整原文入口以及精确片段入口。

已有页面样式工作遵循 [Uteki interface](../uteki-interface/SKILL.md)。此 Skill 不重设计主导航、公司列表或工作台。

## 审阅并改善

把审阅分为两条：**事实是否忠实**，以及**读者是否容易理解**。引用匹配和契约通过不能替代语义审阅；渲染成功不能替代视觉认可。

每轮先记录一个具体问题和可观察目标，例如“共享服务让归属难以辨认；拆辅图后，两种关系都能定位且未丢失”。保留输入与旧版本，只改与问题相关的展示。拆业务/收入视图后，分别核业务覆盖与收入勾稽，不只检查删掉了多少收入边。检查调整前后节点身份、关系和证据未意外变化。事实错误则依据原文另提候选修订，不能作为美化直接改成已采纳事实。

与 Claude 或其他顾问合作时，在已有费用/工具授权内发送同一冻结数据、图和具体审阅问题，请其给出问题、依据、建议及验收例。Codex 核对建议再实施；顾问意见不是来源证据，也不能自动把状态改为 `accepted`。未运行、调用失败和审阅完成分别记录，保留此前失败回执；本地修订不冒称顾问参与。预算不足时完成本地可独立工作，不假称已经确认。

浏览器或截图检查遵守项目约定：用户负责默认视觉审阅；仅在明确要求或需要复现具体浏览器问题时做定向检查。记录实际运行的内容检查、渲染检查、交互检查及未执行项。视觉认可和数据采纳是两种独立状态。

交付时说明图回答什么、改变什么、证据在哪里、仍缺什么，并给出最先要做的一项后续动作。不要把候选小样计为自动业务提取、全报告覆盖或评测集整项完成。
